premises.text: High clothing return rates stem from design around only two of nine body shapes, so fit problems are about shape not just size
premises.evidence_span: The problem with returns is more than just a size or a measurement issue. The solution must include shape

premises.text: Recommendations match garment design details to an individual's body shape and proportion via shape-filter technology
premises.evidence_span: We make recommendations on clothing for an individual body shape and proportion using the design details in an individual garment

premises.text: AI, visual recognition, machine learning, and knowledge-based systems classify assortments while a UI captures shopper shape and proportion
premises.evidence_span: Our AI, visual recognition, machine learning, knowledge-based systems classify assortments. Our user interface captures a shopper's shape and her proportion

premises.text: Enterprise implementation plugs into retailer inventory systems with annual contracts combining upfront fee and percentage of sales
premises.evidence_span: Our enterprise implementation fits easily into our customers' inventory management system. We have an annual contract with an upfront fee and a percentage of sales

value.text: Make dressing well easy by helping women find clothes that fit their shape, increasing sales and decreasing returns
value.evidence_span: Savitude is making dressing well ridiculously easy

secondary_value.text: Help all women, not only idolized body types, shop with confidence
secondary_value.evidence_span: Help women, help all women, and not just the few idolized women

causal_links.evidence_span: one third of clothing be returned because it doesn't fit
making her shopping a whole lot easier
increase your sales, decrease your returns
